message:
## Summary

Updates the `go-junit-report` dependency reference from tag `v0.9.1` to specific commit SHA `cc1f095d5cc5eca2844f5c5ea7bb37f6b9bf6cac` in CI workflows. This change moves away from relying on tags to using explicit commit references for better dependency stability.

**Link to Devin run**: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/d9bc1ac5704042e498ac4d51de7c44fa  
**Requested by**: @keelerm84

## Changes

- `.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml`: Updated `go run github.com/jstemmer/go-junit-report@v0.9.1` to use SHA reference
- `.github/workflows/integration-test.yml`: Updated `go install github.com/jstemmer/go-junit-report@v0.9.1` to use SHA reference

## Testing

- ✅ Local: `make lint` passed
- ✅ Local: `make test` passed
- ⏳ CI: Waiting for CI checks to validate the changes work correctly in the workflow environment

## Review Checklist

- [ ] Verify SHA `cc1f095d5cc5eca2844f5c5ea7bb37f6b9bf6cac` corresponds to the `v0.9.1` tag of `jstemmer/go-junit-report`
- [ ] Confirm all CI checks pass (unit tests, integration tests)
- [ ] Ensure this aligns with the dependency management strategy

**Requirements**

- [x] I have added test coverage for new or changed functionality (N/A - CI configuration change only)
- [x] I have followed the repository's [pull request submission guidelines](../blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#submitting-pull-requests)
- [x] I have validated my changes against all supported platform versions (will be validated by CI)

**Related issues**

Related to SDK-1496 - standardizing go-junit-report dependency references across LaunchDarkly Go repositories.

**Describe the solution you've provided**

Replaced tag-based references (`@v0.9.1`) with commit SHA references (`@cc1f095d5cc5eca2844f5c5ea7bb37f6b9bf6cac`) for the `go-junit-report` tool used in CI workflows. This provides more stability by pinning to a specific commit rather than a potentially mutable tag.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

- Keep using tag references: Rejected because tags can theoretically be moved or deleted
- Use a different version: Not applicable, maintaining compatibility with existing v0.9.1

**Additional context**

This is part of a broader effort to update go-junit-report references across 13 LaunchDarkly Go repositories for consistency and improved dependency management.
